title: Effective volume of wet well

symbols.definition: Effective volume of wet well (in cubic meters)
Time for one pump cycle (in minutes)

applicability: The value of T is related to number of starts per hour and it is not advisable to exceed 6 starts per hour. T in design is taken as 10 minutes for smaller pump capacities but 15 minutes is desirable and hence the denominator in the equation is 4. Ideally this volume is below the invert of the lowest incoming sewer. Where not possible in large pumping stations, volume in sewers calculated at 0.8 times their total volume can be considered extended wet well volume.
